purpose: A row disclosure button with optional nested-item count.
behaviorProvider: Shared data-grid cell adapter; table/record state remains with its host.

component: Render a non-submitting native button with aria-expanded and an action label combining Expand/Collapse, optional count and label.
Stop click and keydown propagation. A click emits onExpandedChange with the inverse of the supplied expanded state, then calls an optional onClick.
host: Own expanded state and render/remove the corresponding detail region. Supply aria-controls and contextual label when there is a target region.
Own lazy loading and errors for expanded content; provide a valid nonnegative count.

requirements.statement: Render a non-submitting native button with aria-expanded and an action label combining Expand/Collapse, optional count and label.
Stop click and keydown propagation. A click emits onExpandedChange with the inverse of the supplied expanded state, then calls an optional onClick.
Keep visible count and icon decorative because the button name already includes their meaning. Forward ordinary button properties, including aria-controls when supplied.
Own expanded state and render/remove the corresponding detail region. Supply aria-controls and contextual label when there is a target region.
Own lazy loading and errors for expanded content; provide a valid nonnegative count.

Use data-display group tokens for owned presentation, preserve genuine nested component ownership, and verify the same geometry across Fundamental and Fundamental Floating in light/dark. Keep the documented semantics and state model when composing or extending this family.

limitations: No target content, lazy fetch, accordion keyboard model or automatic target id is created.
Authored source coverage is separate from executed interaction, visual, accessibility and consumer-package evidence.
